sources.title: PDF Regulatory Dynamics of NBFC: A Comprehensive Study On Formulation and ...
sources.snippet: Employing a doctrinal methodology, the paper identifies key challenges and policy options to ensure that NBFC oversight remains both risk-sensitive and innovation-friendly, especially in the context of fintech convergence. It advocates for a harmonised, forward-looking, and technologically integrated regulatory model for India's NBFC sector.
